entries.identity: ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents (Special Edition objective). NamedCardRef: blueprintIds [7_299, 7_299_BACK]; titleFragments ["isb operations","empire's sinister agents"]. Base ids only — no virtual reprints share either title in card_blueprint_database_dark.json.
sites: LocationRequirement PULL-TARGET (front, setup): Filters.Coruscant_location -> planetOrSystemGroup=CORUSCANT, subtype=ANY_LOCATION, battlegroundRequired=false. "Deploy any Coruscant location."
LocationRequirement FLIP-GATE (front): Filters.Rebel_Base_location -> subtype=SITE (Rebel Base locations), sideOwnership=SELF (controlled). Flip needs ISB agents controlling >=2 of these.

LocationRequirement DRAIN-BONUS (back): Filters.battleground_site occupied by your non-Undercover ISB agent -> subtype=SITE, battlegroundRequired=true. Grants +1 own drain there and -1 opp drain at same/related locations.
characters: CharacterRequirement ISB AGENT (granted, both sides): Filters.and(your, character, loreContains("ISB") OR loreContains("Rebel") OR loreContains("Rebels") OR loreContains("Rebellion")). Engine grants Keyword.ISB_AGENT + Keyword.SPY + ignore-location-deployment-restrictions to these. filterType=loreContains, keyword=ISB_AGENT/SPY (granted, not innate).
CharacterRequirement FLIP COUNT (front): Filters.ISB_agent, count>=4 on table (canSpot 4, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) — alternative flip path.
CharacterRequirement DRAIN GATE (back): Filters.and(ISB_agent, not(undercover_spy)) at a battleground_site — enables the drain modifiers.
CharacterRequirement RETRIEVE (back): Filters.ISB_agent — retrieve one per draw phase.
entries.pullChain: [{phase:SETUP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:LocationRequirement(Filters.Coruscant_location, CORUSCANT/ANY_LOCATION), cadence:ON_DEPLOY, cost:0, enablesFlip:false} — front getGameTextWhenDeployedAction, DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect. {phase:POST_FLIP, verb:retrieve, sourceZone:LOST, target:CharacterRequirement(Filters.ISB_agent), cadence:ONCE_PER_TURN(draw phase), enablesFlip:false} — back RetrieveCardEffect via OncePerPhaseEffect in DRAW phase]
entries.flip: FlipRequirement (front getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers, on table change): alternatives = [ {relation:ON_TABLE(canSpot), count:4, target:CharacterRequirement(Filters.ISB_agent), spotOverride:INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE} OR {relation:CONTROL, count:2, target:LocationRequirement(Filters.Rebel_Base_location), byWhom:CharacterRequirement(Filters.ISB_agent)} ]. Either satisfies -> FlipCardEffect to Empire's Sinister Agents.
entries.flipBack: FlipBackRequirement (back getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers, on table change): {relation:ON_TABLE, count:0, target:CharacterRequirement(Filters.ISB_agent)} — i.e. NOT canSpot any ISB_agent. If no ISB agents on table -> FlipCardEffect back to ISB Operations. Maintain ISB presence to avoid flip-back.
entries.hardLose: none — no "place out of play" / HardLose clause on either side.
weights: NONE — no scoring magnitudes exist for this objective. Live rando handling is V25 detection-only flags in ObjectiveAnalyzer (isISBOperations, isbFlipAgentCount, isbFlipLocationCount via regex, isbFlipBackNoAgents) plus addLocationFragment("rebel base"). No numeric score weight to reuse. Do not invent.

entries.identity: City In The Clouds / You Truly Belong Here With Us (objective, LIGHT, Cloud City + [Virtual Set P] icons). Front title Card301_002 = "City In The Clouds"; back Card301_002_BACK = "You Truly Belong Here With Us".
entries.titleBack: You Truly Belong Here With Us
sites: Bespin system — LocationRequirement{ planetOrSystemGroup: BESPIN, subtype: SYSTEM }. Runtime Filter = Filters.Bespin_system. Deployed at setup (required) and is the flip 'occupy' target.

Cloud City battleground site — LocationRequirement{ planetOrSystemGroup: BESPIN (Cloud City locations), subtype: SITE, battlegroundRequired: true, iconsRequired: [CLOUD_CITY] }. Runtime Filter = Filters.and(Filters.Cloud_City_site, Filters.battleground) at setup; the OPT [download] uses Filters.and(Filters.Cloud_City_location, Filters.battleground); the flip 'control 2' uses Filters.Cloud_City_battleground_site.

Cloud City site (generic, non-battleground-restricted) — LocationRequirement{ planetOrSystemGroup: BESPIN, subtype: SITE }. Runtime Filter = Filters.Cloud_City_site. Used ONLY in count/ownership comparisons: front flip requires opponent controls 0 of these; back react-trigger fires on battle/Force-drain by opponent AT one; back flip-back compares opponent-controlled count vs self-controlled count.
characters: Back-side react mover — CharacterRequirement{ filterType: your(self) + character, abilityConstraint: canMoveAsReactAsActionFromOtherCard }. Runtime Filter = Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.character, Filters.canMoveAsReactAsActionFromOtherCard(self,false,0,false)). No persona/keyword/species/affiliation restriction — ANY friendly character. Once per turn, moved as a 'react' to a battle or Force drain initiated by opponent at a Cloud City site.
entries.flip: FRONT flip (City In The Clouds -> You Truly Belong Here With Us), all required simultaneously (isTableChanged trigger, RequiredGameTextTriggerAction): (1) FlipRequirement{ relation: CONTROL, count: 2, target: LocationRequirement(Cloud_City_battleground_site), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE }; AND (2) FlipRequirement{ relation: OCCUPY, count: 1, target: LocationRequirement(Bespin_system), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE }; AND (3) opponentConstraint{ relation: CONTROL, count: 0, target: LocationRequirement(Cloud_City_site) } — opponent controls no Cloud City sites.
entries.flipBack: BACK flip-back (You Truly Belong Here With Us -> City In The Clouds), RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on isTableChanged: FlipRequirement{ relation: COUNT_COMPARE, condition: opponent-controlled Cloud_City_site count > self-controlled Cloud_City_site count } (both counted via Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE). Negation-ish of the front flip's opponent-controls-none clause.
entries.pullChain: FRONT setup (getGameTextWhenDeployedAction, on deploy of objective): [1] PullOrDeployAction{ phase: SETUP, verb: deploy, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: LocationRequirement(Bespin_system), cadence: ON_DEPLOY, required }; [2] PullOrDeployAction{ phase: SETUP, verb: deploy, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: LocationRequirement(Cloud_City_site + battleground), cadence: ON_DEPLOY, required, enablesFlip: true }; [3] PullOrDeployAction{ phase: SETUP, verb: deploy, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: NamedCardRef(Weather Vane), cadence: ON_DEPLOY, optional (0-1) }. FRONT recurring (top-level, PRE_FLIP): PullOrDeployAction{ phase: PRE_FLIP, verb: download, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: LocationRequirement(Cloud_City_location + battleground), cadence: ONCE_PER_TURN, cost: 1 Force, enablesFlip: true (builds toward the control-2 flip gate) }. BACK (POST_FLIP, top-level): [a] PullOrDeployAction{ phase: POST_FLIP, verb: download, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: NamedCardRef(Cloud City Celebration), cadence: ONCE_PER_GAME }; [b] PullOrDeployAction{ phase: POST_FLIP, verb: upload, sourceZone: RESERVE, target: CharacterRequirement n/a -> Filters.Interrupt (card-type), cadence: ONCE_PER_PHASE (control phase), cost: 2 Force, into hand }.

sites: LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:RALLTIIR, subtype:SYSTEM} -- runtime Filters.Ralltiir_system; deployed from Reserve at setup (when-deployed trigger) and is the hard-lose anchor
LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:RALLTIIR, subtype:SITE, battlegroundRequired:false} -- runtime Filters.Ralltiir_site; flip gate counts >=3 controlled by Imperials

LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:RALLTIIR, subtype:ANY_LOCATION} -- runtime Filters.Ralltiir_location; used in front-flip opponent-controls-none clause, back-flip opponent-controls-2 clause, Rebel deploy +2 modifier, and back total-battle-destiny occupancy count
characters: CharacterRequirement{filterType:Imperial (Icon.IMPERIAL)} -- runtime Filters.Imperial; front flip gate requires Imperials to control >=3 Ralltiir sites (controlsWith ... Filters.Imperial); also non-unique Imperial is a pull target
CharacterRequirement{filterType:Rebel (Icon.REBEL)} -- runtime Filters.Rebel; NOT a requirement, it is a DeployCostToLocationModifier: each Rebel is deploy +2 at Ralltiir locations (both sides)
entries.pullChain: ["PullOrDeployAction{phase:SETUP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:Ralltiir_system, cadence:ON_DEPLOY, enablesFlip:false} -- getGameTextWhenDeployedAction: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Ralltiir_system) at objective deploy; reshuffle", "PullOrDeployAction{phase:PRE_FLIP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target: Filters.or(site, and(non_unique, Imperial)) to Ralltiir, cadence:ONCE_PER_TURN(deploy phase), enablesFlip:true} -- front getGameTextTopLevelActions: DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect, OncePerPhaseEffect, GameTextActionId.RALLTIIR_OPERATIONS__DOWNLOAD_SITE_OR_NONUNIQUE_IMPERIAL_TO_RALLTIIR; reshuffle; builds toward the 3-Ralltiir-sites flip gate", "PullOrDeployAction{phase:POST_FLIP, verb:take, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:any card into hand, cadence:ONCE_PER_TURN(control phase), cost:2 Force, enablesFlip:false} -- back getGameTextTopLevelActions: TakeCardIntoHandFromReserveDeckEffect, UseForceEffect 2, GameTextActionId.IN_THE_HANDS_OF_THE_EMPIRE__UPLOAD_CARD; reshuffle"]
entries.flip: FlipRequirement (front->back): {relation:CONTROL, count:3, target:LocationRequirement{RALLTIIR, SITE}, byWhom:CharacterRequirement{Imperial}} AND opponentConstraint:{relation:CONTROL, count:0, target:LocationRequirement{RALLTIIR, ANY_LOCATION}}. Code: TriggerConditions.isTableChanged && canBeFlipped && controlsWith(self, playerId, 3, Filters.Ralltiir_site, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.Imperial) && !controls(opponent, Filters.Ralltiir_location). Text: "Flip if Imperials control at least three Ralltiir sites and opponent controls no Ralltiir locations."
entries.flipBack: FlipBackRequirement (back->front): {relation:CONTROL, count:2, target:LocationRequirement{RALLTIIR, ANY_LOCATION}, byWhom:opponent}. Code: isTableChanged && canBeFlipped && controls(opponent, 2, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.Ralltiir_location). Text: "Flip if opponent controls at least two Ralltiir locations."

entries.identity: Imperial Occupation (front) / Imperial Control (back), 7_298 / 7_298_BACK, DARK, Special Edition objective. Deploy cost 0 front, 7 back. Icon: SPECIAL_EDITION. Front sets a DYNAMIC "Renegade planet" (any planet system chosen at deploy). Runtime state via game.getGameState().getRenegadePlanet()/setRenegadePlanet(); archetype label carries the chosen system name.
sites: RenegadePlanetSystem: LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:DYNAMIC ("any planet system", chosen at deploy -> becomes the Renegade planet), subtype:SYSTEM}. Java Filter: Filters.planet_system (DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect at setup; card.getBlueprint().getSystemName() -> setRenegadePlanet).

SetupSite: LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:DYNAMIC(Renegade planet), subtype:SITE, iconsRequired:[GENERIC/diamond]}. One ◇ site deployed to the Renegade planet system at setup. Java Filter: Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.site) via DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect(systemName).

OncePerDeployPhaseSite (PRE_FLIP repeatable pull): LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:DYNAMIC(Renegade planet), subtype:SITE, iconsRequired:[GENERIC/diamond]}. Deploy one ◇ site to Renegade planet from Reserve Deck, reshuffle. Java Filter: Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.site) to renegadePlanet. GameTextActionId.IMPERIAL_OCCUPATION__DOWNLOAD_SITE, OncePerPhaseEffect.

FlipGateSites: LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:DYNAMIC(Renegade planet), subtype:SITE, battlegroundRequired:true, sideOwnership:SELF}. Java Filter: Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Renegade_planet_location), controlsWith count 3, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.

FlipBackSites: LocationRequirement{planetOrSystemGroup:DYNAMIC(Renegade planet), subtype:SITE, battlegroundRequired:true, sideOwnership:SELF}. Java Filter: Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Renegade_planet_location), occupies count 2 (negated).
characters: MatchingOperative: CharacterRequirement{filterType: Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet (operative whose matching-planet is the DYNAMIC Renegade planet)}. NEVER a title fragment. Used as byWhom for the flip gate (Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet)), for retrieve-on-deploy trigger, back-side power/forfeit modifiers, and add-battle-destiny gate.
entries.flip: FlipRequirement{relation:CONTROL, count:3, target:LocationRequirement(DYNAMIC Renegade planet, subtype SITE, battlegroundRequired true), byWhom:CharacterRequirement(Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet)}. Java: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, 3, Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Renegade_planet_location), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet)) + isTableChanged + canBeFlipped.
entries.flipBack: FlipBackRequirement{relation:OCCUPY, count:2, negated:true, target:LocationRequirement(DYNAMIC Renegade planet, subtype SITE, battlegroundRequired true), byWhom:SELF}. Java: !GameConditions.occupies(game, playerId, 2, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Renegade_planet_location)) + isTableChanged + canBeFlipped. (Negation of a weaker version of the flip gate: 2 battleground sites occupied vs 3 controlled to flip forward.)
entries.hardLose: None. No "place out of play" / HardLose condition on either side. Loss of the DYNAMIC planet position is handled purely by the flipBack gate.
entries.pullChain: [{phase:SETUP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:LocationRequirement(planet_system, DYNAMIC -> sets Renegade planet), cadence:ON_DEPLOY, cost:0}, {phase:SETUP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:LocationRequirement(◇ generic site to Renegade planet system), cadence:ON_DEPLOY}, {phase:PRE_FLIP, verb:deploy, sourceZone:RESERVE, target:LocationRequirement(◇ generic site to Renegade planet, battleground-capable), cadence:ONCE_PER_TURN (once per deploy phase), enablesFlip:true, note:reshuffle after}]. Back side (POST_FLIP) has no Reserve pull; instead retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to the Renegade planet (RetrieveForceEffect, OptionalGameTextTrigger on justDeployedToLocation).
entries.existingVtags: None. No V-tag or objective-specific logic for Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control / Renegade planet exists in src/gemp-swccg-server/.../ai/models/rando (evaluators + strategy + ObjectiveAnalyzer all grep-clean for renegade/occupation/7_298/matchingOperative/subjugat). Only incidental game_log references to the unrelated "Cloud City Occupation" card. No weights to reuse or cite.
namedCards: NamedCardRef{title:Imperial Occupation/Imperial Control, blueprintIds:[7_298, 7_298_BACK], titleFragments:["imperial occupation","imperial control"], side:DARK} — the objective itself; the flip-gateway. No other NAMED cards are pulled or gated on; all pull targets are broad LocationRequirements (planet system, ◇ generic site) resolved by Filters, not named cards.
entries.notes: DYNAMIC-planet objective (analog to Local Uprising 7_137, the LIGHT-side counterpart): the "Renegade planet" is chosen at deploy from any planet system, so every LocationRequirement/CharacterRequirement here must resolve against game state's renegadePlanet at decision time, never a static planet group. The text token "◇ site" is implemented in Java as Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.site) (generic/diamond marker site), NOT a title token. "matching operatives" = Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet (operative whose matching planet equals the Renegade planet) — express as CharacterRequirement filterType, never a lore/title fragment. Only base blueprint ids exist; no virtual reprints in card_blueprint_database_dark.json. Back id verified as 7_298_BACK (not 7_299). Both flip gates use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE. Back-side extras (not pull-relevant, listed for completeness): opponent Force drains -1; matching operatives on planet forfeit +2 and power +2 when at same site as a Rebel; add 1 battle destiny once per battle when a matching operative is in a battle on the Renegade planet.

entries.identity: No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave? (DARK objective, Coruscant / Episode I). Tatooine/Watto lock-down: deploy Watto's Junkyard + Mos Espa at setup, then keep Watto present at Watto's Junkyard while occupying Mos Espa to hold the front side.
entries.titleFront: No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
sites: LocationRequirement NamedCardRef 'Watto's Junkyard' -> Filters.Wattos_Junkyard (Tatooine SITE). blueprintIds: 12_178 (dark), 12_87 (light). titleFragments: ['tatooine: watto's junkyard']. Deployed from Reserve at setup; front side makes it immune to Revolution for remainder of game.

LocationRequirement NamedCardRef 'Mos Espa' -> Filters.Mos_Espa (Tatooine SITE). blueprintIds: 11_93, 208_56 (dark), 11_43, 221_75 (light). titleFragments: ['tatooine: mos espa']. Deployed from Reserve at setup; occupancy is half the flip gate.

LocationRequirement broad 'Tatooine sites' -> Filters.Tatooine_site (planetGroup=TATOOINE, subtype=SITE, sideOwnership=ANY). Front side caps opponent Force loss from your Force drains here at max 1. Runtime resolve only, no candidate id snapshot.
characters: CharacterRequirement persona WATTO -> Filters.Watto. blueprintIds: 11_65, 11_66 (dark). Gate character: must be present at Watto's Junkyard for the front flip; also the opponent's place-Watto-in-Used-Pile-for-8-Force target (you may retrieve up to 4) on both sides.

CharacterRequirement persona QUI_GON -> Filters.QuiGon (LIGHT). blueprintIds: 11_10, 11_11, 13_39, 14_27, 213_40. Front side grants Qui-Gon power +3 (flavor buff to opponent's Qui-Gon, not a Rando pull target).

CharacterRequirement (back side) opponent's non-unique aliens -> Filters.and(opponents, non_unique, alien): species/keyword alien, uniqueness NON_UNIQUE, sideOwnership OPPONENT. Each is deploy cost +3 while back side up. Runtime resolve only.
entries.flip: Front -> Back ('You're A Slave?'): flip if Watto present at Watto's Junkyard AND you occupy Mos Espa. Code: getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers on isTableChanged + canBeFlipped + canSpot(Watto presentAt Wattos_Junkyard, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) + occupies(playerId, Mos_Espa). enablesFlip gate = the setup deploy of both sites.
entries.flipBack: Back -> Front ('No Money, No Parts, No Deal!'): flip if Watto NOT present at Watto's Junkyard OR you do NOT occupy Mos Espa. Negation of the front flip (canSpot Watto/presentAt Wattos_Junkyard is false OR occupies Mos_Espa is false).
entries.hardLose: None. No place-out-of-play / lose-game condition on either side.
entries.pullChain: SETUP (getGameTextWhenDeployedAction, both required, ON_DEPLOY, sourceZone RESERVE): (1) DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect target Filters.Wattos_Junkyard; (2) DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect target Filters.Mos_Espa. No pre-flip or post-flip pulls. Back side has a once-per-deploy-phase place-card-from-hand-face-down mechanic (opponent loses 2 Force or pays 2 to let you deploy it free) but that is a table/hand action, not a Reserve pull.

entries.identity: Death Star II dark-side objective, CAPTURE archetype. FRONT "Bring Him Before Me": on deploy, deploy Throne Room + Insignificant Rebellion + Your Destiny from Reserve. Locks Scanning Crew (may-not-play for game) and protects Luke from opponent place-out-of-play. Dark may download Emperor (deploy -2). Opponent may download Luke from Reserve (deploy -2) or Lost Pile. If Luke is present with a non-escorting Vader, Luke is captured+seized by Vader; Vader may not transfer him. Flips when the capture target becomes a captive. A game-text mod (Kanan, Rebel Infiltrator) can redirect the whole objective to target Leia or Kanan instead of Luke. BACK "Take Your Father's Place": lose 1 Force each of your turns; once/turn, with Vader+Luke+Emperor all present at your Throne Room, initiate a Luke/Vader duel (each draws 2 destiny + ability); Vader win = opp loses 3 Force; Luke win = shuffle Reserve, draw destiny, if >12 Luke crosses to Dark Side and totally depletes opponent's Life Force. Flips back if Luke neither present with Vader nor a captive.
sites: NamedCardRef Throne Room — Filters.Throne_Room = Filters.title("Death Star II: Throne Room") -> blueprintId 9_147 (DARK, LOCATION/SITE). Capture requires Luke present with Vader (any site, per the present-with check, not gated to Throne Room); the BACK-side duel is gated to 'present at your Throne Room' (9_147).

Capture target (primary): CharacterRequirement persona=LUKE (Filters.Luke). Downloaded by opponent from Reserve/Lost Pile; captured when present with Vader; protected from opponent place-out-of-play (except We Need Luke Skywalker).

Capture target alternatives via game-text mod: persona=LEIA (Filters.Leia) or persona=KANAN (Filters.Kanan). Redirect triggers when opponent deploys 'Kanan, Rebel Infiltrator' as the downloaded Luke — BRING_HIM_BEFORE_ME__TARGETS_LEIA/KANAN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE.
Emperor: CharacterRequirement persona=SIDIOUS (Filters.Emperor). Downloadable from Reserve (deploy -2, reshuffle) on both sides; must be present at Throne Room to enable the back-side duel.
entries.flip: FlipRequirement: relation=CAPTURED, count=1, target=CharacterRequirement(persona=LUKE) [alternatives: persona=LEIA, persona=KANAN per active game-text mod]. Front->back fires (RequiredGameTextTriggerAction, singleton) when the target is spottable as a captive (SpotOverride INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) and card canBeFlipped. Text: "Flip this card if Luke captured."
entries.flipBack: FlipBackRequirement (negation): back->front fires when the target is NOT spottable as (captive OR present-with Vader). i.e. relation=NOT(CAPTURED OR PRESENT_WITH Vader), target=CharacterRequirement(persona=LUKE) [alternatives LEIA/KANAN]. Text: "Flip if Luke neither present with Vader nor a captive."

entries.notes: Java is authoritative (setGameText read from Card9_151.java + Card9_151_BACK.java). filtersUsedInJava: Filters.Throne_Room, Filters.Insignificant_Rebellion, Filters.Your_Destiny, Filters.Scanning_Crew (all Filters.title), plus persona filters Filters.Emperor(SIDIOUS), Filters.Luke, Filters.Leia, Filters.Kanan, Filters.Vader. Redirect mechanic: ModifyGameTextType.BRING_HIM_BEFORE_ME__TARGETS_LEIA/KANAN_INSTEAD_OF_LUKE swaps the persona the objective captures/duels/protects; Rando should treat the flip target as {LUKE default, LEIA or KANAN if that mod is active}. Capture is a required auto-trigger (isTableChanged) when target present with a valid Vader — Rando does not choose it, but positioning Vader present with an uncaptured Luke IS the pull-the-trigger decision. OOP protection car/We_Need_Luke_Skywalker (211_36_BACK) is the sole exception to Luke place-out-of-play immunity. No back-side id exists beyond 9_151_BACK; back is same physical card. ID VERIFICATION (2026-07-07): all 8 idsUsed independently confirmed against source. 7 present in card_blueprint_database_dark.json with correct DARK side + title (9_151 Bring Him Before Me OBJECTIVE, 9_151_BACK Take Your Father's Place OBJECTIVE, 9_147 Death Star II: Throne Room LOCATION, 9_127 Insignificant Rebellion EFFECT, 210_47 Insignificant Rebellion EFFECT, 9_134 Your Destiny EFFECT, 1_266 Scanning Crew INTERRUPT). 211_36_BACK confirmed in card_blueprint_database_light.json = We Need Luke Skywalker OBJECTIVE LIGHT (front 211_36 = The Galaxy May Need A Legend).
